blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Seventeen Filipino seafarers were confirmed safe after the tanker they were aboard collided with an American passenger riverboat on the Mississippi River, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said on Sunday. The incident involved the tanker Atlantic Asphalt and the riverboat American Heritage near the Port of New Orleans in Louisiana on Nov. 13. “Verification with the Local Manning Agency (LMA) confirmed that all 17 Filipino crew members aboard the Atlantic Asphalt are accounted for and safe,” the DMW said in a statement.
